A0YT:
繼承所選敵方英雄的一項技能。

使用「-clear skill」指令可以重新選擇敵方英雄。

Inherits an ability of the chosen enemy hero.

With the "-clear skill" command you can re-select the enemy hero.
A0ZM:
由英雄或暗影完成的擊殺，有機率創造出被殺敵人的暗影，為英雄而戰。

啟動技能可在創造無敵暗影與可受傷暗影兩種模式之間切換。

暗影出現機率：30%
暗影存在時間：10 秒／7.5 秒
暗影特性：無敵／75% 生命值上限

Kills made by the hero or by his shadows can create shadows of the slain enemies that fight on the hero's side.

Activating the ability toggles between creating invulnerable and vulnerable shadows.

Shadow appearance chance: 30%
Shadow lifetime: 10 sec./7.5 sec.
Shadow characteristics: invulnerability/75% health pool
A0ZN: 九頭蛇每提升一級都會成長，並獲得 +50 生命值上限、+2 生命回復與 +5 攻擊力。
With each level gained, the hydra grows and receives +50 maximum health, +2 health regeneration and +5 attack power.
A0ZO: 你可以將屬於植物、食物或生物的物品移動到第二背包（F2）。如此一來第二背包中可以擁有 1 件物品。
You can move an item that is a plant, food or organism into the second inventory (F2). In this way you can have 1 item in the second inventory.

Explosion damage: 45 + (20% spell power) per sec.
Explosion duration: 2.6 sec.
Fire pool damage: 10 + (5% spell power) per sec.
Fire pool duration: 8 sec.

AIbk:
將英雄傳送一小段距離。

冷卻：30 秒。

加成持續時間：10 秒

Cast range: 700
Penetration bonus: 20 + (10% spell power)
Bonus duration: 10 sec.

英雄進入隱形並獲得移動速度加成。從隱形中發動的攻擊會對敵人造成額外魔法傷害，並為英雄回復生命值。

Damage of the strike from invisibility: 100 + (400% penetration) + (40% spell power)
Magic lifesteal: 33%
Movement speed bonus: 10%
Duration: 11 sec.

Cooldown: 11 sec.

英雄以屏障護體，降低所受的傷害。屏障結束後，英雄附近的隨機敵人會受到傷害，英雄本身則獲得暫時的攻擊力與生命回復加成。

屏障持續時間：5 秒

加成持續時間：8 秒

冷卻：24 秒

The hero shields herself with a barrier that reduces incoming damage. After the barrier ends, random enemies near the hero take damage, and the hero herself gains a temporary bonus to attack power and health regeneration.

Incoming damage reduction from the barrier: 20%
Barrier duration: 5 sec.
Damage after the barrier: 70 + (25% spell power) to 7 random enemies near the hero
Bonus after the barrier: +20 + (10% spell power) attack power, +4 + (3% spell power) health regeneration

Cooldown: 24 sec.

效果持續時間：10 秒

效果冷卻：效果結束後 10 秒

Damage: 16 + (5% spell power) per sec.

英雄的攻擊會削弱敵人，降低其造成的傷害並提高其受到的傷害。此效果可以疊加，但不會刷新持續時間。

造成傷害降低：8%
受到傷害提高：8%
持續時間：6 秒

冷卻：3.5 秒

The hero's attacks weaken the enemy, reducing the damage it deals and increasing the damage it takes. This effect can stack, but without refreshing the duration.
